prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
The smartphone is not disappearing. But it may be losing its role as the one place where digital life begins.

Several signals point in the same direction. Digital assistants are moving from a screen to places where people already are: a car, a room, a wrist, glasses, or earbuds.

Google says Gemini Intelligence for Android will handle tasks such as booking a ride or shopping. It will first come to selected Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel phones. Google plans to bring it to watches, cars, glasses, and laptops later in 2026.

Google has also announced an experimental desktop feature called Agent Mode. It is designed to browse the web, do research, and use Google apps with little help from the user. These are product plans and an experiment, not proof that most people already give tasks to software.

Amazon has made Alexa+ available in the United States through Alexa devices, Alexa.com, and the Alexa app. Amazon describes help with takeout, restaurant bookings, rides, and home repairs. Google’s Gemini for Home is aimed at speakers, displays, cameras, and doorbells.

Cars are becoming another important doorway. Google says more than 250 million cars support Android Auto, and it plans to bring Gemini to cars. Google also says Pixel Buds can give people hands-free access to Gemini.

Glasses show the same direction. Meta says millions of Ray-Ban Meta glasses have been sold. Google’s first commercial Android XR product is planned as audio-only glasses for fall 2026. The camera-and-display glasses shown earlier are a separate product, with no confirmed launch date in the cited announcement.

Taken together, these signals do not show a finished replacement for the smartphone. They show something quieter: digital help is being placed in more than one doorway.

【Point One】
Google’s plan to take Gemini from selected phones to watches, cars, glasses, and laptops shows the strategic shift. Alexa+ works across devices, the web, and an app. Gemini for Home reaches speakers, displays, cameras, and doorbells. The question is becoming: which assistant can stay useful across the places where one task happens?

【Point Two】
Amazon reports 600 million active Alexa endpoints. That is Amazon’s term, not a count of people. It also says tens of millions joined Alexa+ Early Access. Meta reports millions of glasses sold, while Google reports Android Auto in more than 250 million cars. Amazon also reports more conversations, purchases, music streaming, and smart-home use. The picture is mixed: access is spreading, but broad smartphone replacement is not yet shown.
